Lionheart who pardons Robin in the later royal ending.

How King Richard connects

  • Artist: Robin of Sherwood — Richard pardons Robin after testing the band in disguise.
  • Character: Prince John — Richard's return undoes John's usurpation in the later plot.

What is King Richard?

Richard I is the good king of the Gest and many novels: he comes in disguise, tests the band, and restores Robin to the peace — a crown the sheriff cannot claim.

Key threads lead to Robin of Sherwood and Prince John.
